name: The Heart Remembers
objective: Return to the chapel one last time. Reforge the Winterheart — the promise, renewed — and let the office of Krampus rest.
intro: The heart of ice is no longer alone. The six bells have grown into it, roots into soil, and where it hung there is now a single warm seal shaped like a bell.
dialogue: Director Krampus: "The office is closed. You may hang the seal wherever you like — it will not ring again unless the world forgets."
Hunter Sigrun: "...My family waited nine generations to be unnecessary. I hope you know what you've given us."
The Midnight Ringer: "Go home, child. Sleep. You've earned a night without listening."
lore_discovery: The Winterheart Seal is forged and the saga ends. A single Pokémon — drawn by the last true ring of the Chorus — chooses to stay with the player as the chapel's lights go out.
